nodes.label: Single Page Apps for GitHub Pages (rafrex)
nodes.author: Rafael Pedicini

nodes.label: HAXcms site architecture (root shell + custom bundle)
nodes.rationale: Editable app code is split between the root site shell and custom/src web components; many files are legacy fallback code so change only targeted lines. No root lint/test/typecheck scripts exist; do not invent them.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages build/deploy prep (scripts/ghpages-build.js)
nodes.rationale: ghpages-build.js renames ghpages.html to index.html, deletes the old index.html, then removes build/ and wc-registry.json; custom/build/ is intentionally kept out of gitignore so the site can serve built custom elements.

nodes.label: HAXcms micro-site
nodes.rationale: HAXcms seeks to be the smallest possible back-end CMS to make HAX work and build websites with it; leveraging JSON Outline Schema it authors multiple pages which it then writes onto the file system.

nodes.label: HAXcms custom development workflow (custom/README)
nodes.rationale: Lets you make customizations without redoing the entire HAXcms build process — build a custom theme for a single site or add new elements into scope of HAXcms; a watch automatically builds ES6/Chrome-based output.

nodes.label: quiz-dashboard-lite2 web component
nodes.rationale: DDD + Lit web component based on the OpenWC toolchain: look good via DDD/HAX design system, simple easy-to-read code via Lit, great workflow via OpenWC tooling + Vercel for sharing demos, simplify contribution to the HAX ecosystem, publish and distribute via npmjs.com. Credited to the Penn State HAXTheWeb initiative.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions Build & Deploy to GitHub Pages workflow
Demo: Lecturer mode dashboard
nodes.rationale: view-mode="lecturer" activates the gear button for manual UTS/UAS score entry, weight configuration, and rapor (report) generation.

nodes.label: Demo: Full activity integration (Aktivitas+Tugas+Forum+Kuis)
nodes.rationale: All components connect to Google Sheets via code.gs; documents the data-flow table mapping actions to sheets (Users, Tugas Log, Forum Log, [Pertemuan]-Kuis, [Pertemuan]-Aktivitas, Akumulasi Nilai Rapor) and the events quiz-user-login, assignment-saved, discussion-saved, quiz-saved, reading-saved.

nodes.label: Demo: Quiz exam mode (hide-answers + hide-confetti)
nodes.rationale: hide-answers and hide-confetti provide an exam mode without correct/wrong feedback or confetti — suitable for final exams (UTS/UAS); CSS fallback keeps answer buttons visible even when the host page does not initialize DDD CSS variables; Lit warning avoided by queueMicrotask instead of setTimeout.

nodes.label: Demo: Assignment & forum (attendance requirement)
nodes.rationale: A student counts as present in a week only after at least 1 assignment AND 1 forum post; assignment-saved and discussion-saved events are recorded to Google Sheets via activity-logger; assignment is locked after submission (can be reset); forum uses localStorage.

nodes.label: Tutor: Standalone AKM worksheet simulation (vanilla JS)
nodes.rationale: Single-file HTML+CSS+vanilla JS template combining a stimulus box with 5 AKM question types with hardcoded answer keys in the frontend (database-less scenario); designed to be copied directly into the HAXcms source-code editor without wrapping into a full web component.

nodes.label: hitungSkorAKM client-side scoring function
nodes.rationale: Scores 5 question types against a hardcoded KUNCI object, converts points to a 0-100 scale; essay is auto-graded by minimum character length plus essential keyword detection (kerja/ekonomi/tani).

nodes.label: Tutor: Complete AKM question types demo (explode-quiz)
AKM question type formats (PG, PGK, Menjodohkan, Isian Singkat)
nodes.rationale: JSON question schema: correctIndex for single-choice, correctAnswers array for multi-correct, type:"pgk" with statements for true/false, type:"matching" with leftItems/rightItems/correctPairs, type:"shortAnswer" with acceptedAnswers; all scoring gives 1 point only when fully correct.

nodes.label: Tutorial v3 changelog (bug fixes + new properties)
nodes.rationale: deleteForumComment removes parent plus all replies; _findAndUpdateComment recursive helper fixes votes on nested replies; _isValidUrl validates Google Drive links; _shouldShowGradebook gates gradebook on showAfterQuiz/showAfterDate.

nodes.label: Tutorial v4 changelog (bug fixes + features)
nodes.rationale: gradebookHidden was removed because an unrendered gradebook cannot listen for events — the gradebook is now always in the DOM with internal visibility; TransparentGradebook gained a quiz-saved listener; per-choice image URLs and matching partial (proportional per-pair) scoring were added; edit button allowed from question screen.

nodes.label: Tutorial v5 changelog (defaults, tab order, DDD fallback)
nodes.rationale: Dashboard always passes showAfterQuiz=true to transparent-gradebook so wait-until-quiz behavior works with no extra setup; quizTabHidden now defaults to true; question-text CSS uses DDD tokens first with hardcoded fallbacks.

nodes.label: Demo: Ujian Akhir Semester (UAS)
nodes.rationale: quiz-category="uas" feeds into the final grade calculation (weight 2/8); sheet-name="UAS" targets a dedicated sheet; lecturers can input or manually edit UAS scores directly in Google Sheets or via lecturer mode.

nodes.label: explode-quiz component
nodes.rationale: Supports 5 question types (mc/pgk/matching/shortAnswer), multi-correct checkboxes, image URLs, shuffle-choices (Fisher-Yates with originalIndex in _correctMap for scoring), quizCategory (formatif/ulangan_harian/uts/uas) sent to Apps Script via params, and an editor with type dropdown + image URL; DDD CSS variables carry hardcoded fallbacks so buttons stay visible without the DDD theme.

nodes.label: assignment-forum component
nodes.rationale: Lit component for independent assignments + discussion forum (Disqus-style nested replies, likes with negative votes, sorting); assignment supports a Google Drive/Docs link input validated by _isValidUrl; persists to Tugas Log / Forum Log sheets; dispatches a3-activity-logged after submit.

nodes.label: quiz-user-auth component
nodes.rationale: Student login/registration writing to the Users sheet; dispatches quiz-user-login whose detail (studentId, nama, nis, absen, kelas) is propagated to the other components; session verification uses queueMicrotask to avoid the Lit scheduled-update warning.

nodes.label: transparent-gradebook component
nodes.rationale: Grade transparency for students plus lecturer mode with 6 weight components (Kehadiran:UH:UTS:UAS:Sikap:Skill) and rapor generation; _shouldShowGradebook() gates visibility on showAfterQuiz and showAfterDate; always rendered in the DOM so it can listen for quiz-saved, a3-activity-logged and a3-force-reload events.

nodes.label: activity-logger component
nodes.rationale: Tracks reading, discussion, and assignment activity for attendance; activity events are recorded to Google Sheets plus localStorage; supplies the attendance thresholds feed for attendance-system.

nodes.label: attendance-system.js
nodes.rationale: DEFAULT_GRADES weights 1:3:2:2 (total 8); totalWeight is now auto-calculated from component weights so the client never uses a stale default tw=8 after weights change; _getFinalScore() prefers server attendance; _resetWeights() restores defaults via localStorage + a3-force-reload; _fetchRoster() pulls real roster from getStudentRoster.

nodes.label: code.gs Google Apps Script backend
nodes.rationale: Server side on Google Apps Script: getStudentRoster() reads Users + Akumulasi Nilai Rapor + Aktivitas sheets; generateReport(weights) computes final grades with dynamic weights passed from the client; deleteForumComment removes parents plus replies; Tugas Log gained a Link column.

nodes.label: Google Sheets data layer via Apps Script
nodes.rationale: Backendless architecture: all components persist through Google Apps Script web-app URLs (apps-script-url / forum-api-url) into named sheets (Users, Tugas Log, Forum Log, [Pertemuan]-Kuis/Aktivitas, Akumulasi Nilai Rapor) — no database or custom server required; teachers can edit scores directly in the sheets.

nodes.label: Weekly attendance threshold rule
nodes.rationale: A student is counted as present if, within one week, they complete at least 1 assignment AND 1 forum post; attendance-system.js DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS: minWeeklyActivities 10, minAssignment 1, minDiscussion 1, minReading 5, minQuiz 1.
